name: davebben-skills
description: Dave's personal collection of Claude Code plugins, one per area of life. Install the ones you want. The SDLC plugin takes an engineering change from a vague ask to a verified production change; more areas (finance, fitness) are on the way.

plugins.name: SDLC
plugins.description: Story-first engineering with the evidence behind each step, in five skills. story writes each change as an outcome, a Not doing list and numbered cases with concrete values, asking only where two readings diverge, and splits or reviews stories. deliver builds one story at a time: a fresh agent writes the failing tests from the story alone, the tests are locked, the session writes the code, one fresh review checks its own findings, and the user confirms before a pull request into main. architecture spikes unknowns and records each expensive decision with the user's reasons. guardrails writes AGENTS.md and the checks. review-code reviews pull requests, the user's own code and designs through the same review agent.

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Skills for managing an agent session's context across boundaries. Today it hands a session over when context fills or work stops partway, recording the dead ends a fresh session would otherwise rediscover.

plugins.name: meals
plugins.description: Skills for eating to numbers without cooking from a spreadsheet. It builds reusable meal templates: a recipe the user already makes, paired with a fixed add-on that closes the gap to a calorie ceiling and protein and fiber floors, proven as a real dish before it is proven as macros, then written back to the recipe manager with ingredients that scale. It then plans days of meals from those templates, stretching batch dinners across days, checking daily averages against targets, and writing the meal plan and a shopping list to the recipe manager.

plugins.name: personalize
plugins.description: Skills that make an agent act as you. sound-like-me composes texts, work replies, docs and scripts in your own voice by following private voice profiles kept outside the repo, never inventing facts and never sending without your say-so.

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: Skills for learning a topic in a format the reader absorbs. teach-like-stackoverflow answers a programming or computer-science question as a mock Stack Overflow thread on one HTML page: an asker's real error, an accepted answer with short working code and a traced example, follow-up comments, and further answers that each solve it a different way. Every code block is run before it goes on the page.

plugins.name: skills-craft
plugins.description: Skills for writing instructions an agent reads. review-skill reviews a SKILL.md, its reference files or a subagent prompt line by line: it cuts what the model already knows or can read, keeps the conventions it cannot infer, names failures specifically, and reports each finding with the evidence behind it.
